name: BSP_AwardTracker_GetSingleton
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_on_move_map, read-only analysis. Provisional; the subject is inferred from its callees, not from a symbol. Double-checked lazy singleton: cache DAT_00e198d0, allocates 0xA0 bytes, constructs via 004e18e0 under the singleton-lifetime critical section. 40 callers. In BSP_Game_OnMove it is called seven times in a row at 004e525e-004e52b5, each time followed by mov ecx,eax and one update whose string tables are unit-class ids (00692b60), weapon ids (006926f0), ENGINE/PERISCOPE/WATER (00692580), CAPTURE1STGET/LANDING1STGET (00692fd0) and SM1STGET (00692960).

name: BSP_Game_RunConsoleCommandQueue
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall, ECX = game, no arguments; sole caller BSP_Game_OnMove at 004e4a5e, the first call of the frame. Returns immediately unless the command list at game+638h has a nonzero count at game+640h and the state-request queue at game+5E8h is empty, so a console command never races a pending state transition. Node head at game+63Ch; the front string is fetched through 004cecf0 and compared with 004beb60 (length plus literal). Recognised commands and effect: 'frames' (00ce7f54) handled only in states 5, 0Dh, 8 or 15h then popped; 'term' (00ce7f4c) enqueues request 10h at 004e23c8; 'pause' (00ce4ab0) enqueues 12h at 004e23fb; 'quit' (00ce7f44) enqueues 13h at 004e242e; the scene branch over '.scn' (00ce7888), 'scenes' (00ce7f3c), 'universe/scenes/' (00ce7f28) and 'command_line_mission' (00ce7f10) enqueues 0Ah at 004e270c. docs/GAME_FRAME_CONTROL.md.

name: BSP_Game_OnInit
evidence: Recovered scope label: the body references the literal GGame::OnInit (004e3aa0 is the only referencing function). __thiscall, ECX = the GGame object, no stack arguments. Sets game+5D4h to 3, releases the 00e198bc singleton, and behind the once-guard at game+719Ch preloads the effect roots Particles\Textures\, Effects\Flares\Textures\, Effects\Traceline\ and Effects\Numbers\ through 00aeff40 plus the atlas interface/textures/common.ats, then brings up about thirty mission subsystems. Reached from 004e5540 only on the .scn direct-load path. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_GAME_ENTRY.md.

name: BSP_Game_DrainStateRequestQueue
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_on_move_map, read-only analysis. __fastcall(GGame*). Loops while game+0x5E8 (pending count) is nonzero, consuming entries from the ring described by game+0x5E0 (capacity) and game+0x5E4 (head byte offset), wrapping when the index passes capacity. Sole caller BSP_Game_OnMove at 004e4d0d, guarded by game+0x5EC == 0 (re-entrancy). The producer for the same fields is 004d3ed0, already named BSP_Game_EnqueueStateRequest. | Queue layout resolved: game+5D8h is an MSVC std::deque<int> with DEQUESIZ 4 (004d3f13 mallocs a 10h-byte block, 004e4498 indexes map[off/4][off%4]); +5DCh block map, +5E0h block count, +5E4h head offset in elements, +5E8h element count, +5D8h itself an unused allocator slot. Block index is off/4 minus the block count once when it is not smaller. pop_front at 004e44a4 wraps the head at block_count*4 and resets it to zero when the queue empties; blocks are never freed. Ordering rule: first in first out, and because 004e4866 re-reads the count after every handler a request a handler enqueues is serviced in the same pass, behind the ones already queued. Request 0Dh leaves the loop at 004e47ec with the rest of the queue intact; request 13h sets 00e1ae75 (the application exit byte read by the application frame) at 004e48cd and returns without the tail; one sub-path of the 10h teardown arm returns at 004e48d7. Dispatch: 02h->004d8000, 04h->004e4000, 05h/08h/0Ch/15h no call, 06h->00e198ac vtable+Ch, 07h->004bfc70, 09h->00e198b4 vtable+Ch, 0Ah/0Bh->004dfb70, 0Eh->004c6b00, 0Fh->004d7970(0), 10h->004e458a which leaves state 11h and enqueues 04h when the queue is empty, 12h sets state 0Dh then 004cd0f0(1,1,1), 14h->004bac20, 16h->00e198b8 vtable+Ch. Tail at 004e4873: in state 0Dh the full 004c43c0 edge test on action 8 (instance+4h+180h) runs 004d7970(0); in state 10h the state becomes 8 when 00e198b4 exists with its +3Ch set, otherwise 5; every path that reaches the tail calls 00a95960 with the scaled delta at game+21F0h. OnMove drains only when game+5ECh is zero (004e4d02). docs/GAME_FRAME_CONTROL.md. | Correction to the earlier game_on_move_map text in this record: game+5E0h is a block count, not an element capacity, and game+5E4h is an offset in elements, not in bytes; the element capacity is game+5E0h * 4.

name: BSP_Game_OnMove
evidence: Name supported by GGame::OnMove and GGame::OnMove::game profiler strings. ECX game, float stack delta, calls close policy004ca2f0 before state-dependent simulation/render work. Bounded Capstone CFG audit against original bytes reaches745 instructions/152 call sites/two RETs; calls assumed to return. Stored Ghidra body remains only8 bytes despite recreate/disassembly; decompiler traverses more code. Not reconstructed; game state+5D4h and frame phase+34h distinct.

name: BSP_Game_BeginStartupSequence
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Supersedes the provisional BSP_Game_OnInit from docs/APP_INITIALIZE_MAP.md: the string GGame::OnInit belongs to 004e3aa0, not here. __thiscall, ECX = the GGame object (application+14h, mirrored at 00e188a8), no stack arguments, RET at 004e57ab/004e5814/004e582c.
